title: history-sync/1.1/search-request
description: Asks a sibling device for the messages of one conversation whose text matches a query, newest first.

id.description: Message ID; the search-response carries it as thid.

from.description: The requesting device's Device DID. Always present: every message of this protocol is sent sender-authenticated, and a receiver acts on it only if that DID is in its roster.

to.description: The one sibling device asked. Never broadcast.

query.description: Plain text. Split on whitespace into terms; every term must occur in a matching message's current text, compared case-insensitively.

limit.description: Maximum matches to return. The responder may return fewer and may cap it.

before.description: Return only matches older than this message id, for paging. Absent: from the newest.
